scene: A mechanical brass fish bobs inside the swirling hot pool.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the warm stone terrace. On the left, steam rises from the round wooden tub containing a clockwork brass fish. The player stands beside it, wearing her lilac headscarf, mustard coat, and brown satchel. A smiling bath attendant holding towels stands right of the pool, beside stone stairs on the far right.
shown: a wind-up brass fish bobbing in the wooden tub on the left
a bath attendant holding folded towels standing right of the tub
carved stone stairs leading upward on the far right
